question: Should maintainers refresh and land the Codex plugin-owned lane-release fix with focused runner proof, require live wedge proof first, or pause the bot replacement?
rationale: The source-level bug and repair shape are clear, but read-only review cannot decide whether focused regression proof is enough for this session/message-risk change or resolve the conflicting branch state.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Carry the hook wiring onto current main, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the focused runner regression as sufficient for the lane-release contract.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a live or Crabbox Codex app-server wedge demonstrates that late cleanup does not corrupt session state or delivery.

options.title: Pause Or Close Replacement
options.body: Stop this bot replacement if maintainers do not want to pursue proof or adoption on the now-conflicting branch.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Carry the hook wiring onto current main, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the focused runner regression as sufficient for the lane-release contract.
